input: Research local Montessori preschool enrollment timelines

gold.taskTitle: Research Montessori Preschool Enrollment Timelines Locally
gold.taskDescription: Research the enrollment timelines for local Montessori preschools to understand deadlines, processes, and requirements for securing a spot.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Identify the specific geographic area to focus the school research on.

questions.title: How old is the child enrolling in preschool?
questions.description: Determine the child's current age or birth date to match age eligibility requirements.

questions.title: What school year are you targeting for enrollment?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is for the upcoming school year or a future one.

questions.title: Have you already identified specific schools to research?
questions.description: Determine whether a shortlist of schools exists or if discovery is also part of the task.

questions.title: Is this for a public, private, or charter Montessori program?
questions.description: Narrow the scope by clarifying the type of Montessori program being considered.

questions.title: What specific enrollment details matter most to you?
questions.description: Understand whether the priority is open house dates, application deadlines, waitlist processes, or tuition timelines.

questions.title: Where do you want to track and store this research?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred format for organizing findings, such as a spreadsheet, doc, or notes app.
